question.text: Under the AIF Code of Conduct, the Manager and KMP must NOT:

answer.text: Make misleading statements about qualifications or capability

explanation.text: The Logic: The Code of Conduct expressly prohibits making misleading or inaccurate statements (oral or written) about qualifications or capability to render investment management services. The Trap: All other options are positive duties under the Code (fiduciary conduct, due diligence, confidentiality).
